default_mode: synthetic-only; set GLUCOTWIN_LOCAL_REPLAY=1 to enable approved local sources
measurement_time: source elapsed minute mapped onto artificial UTC session epoch; original naive source timezone remains unknown
assumed_arrival_time: same as mapped measurement time; zero simulated delay is an assumption
clock: Single manager task; monotonic wall time drives each session virtual time. Snapshots never advance it.
history: 61 minute cells covering inclusive [t-60,t], spanning 60 elapsed minutes
target: exact origin+30 elapsed minutes, not six subsequent records
phase_rules: Unchanged configs/stage5_protocol.json; full support purging and at least 100 eligible matured pairs
warm_start: All minute events processed by the same engine: synthetic to minute120; local to first inherited grid issue with history_start>=anchor+48h

synthetic_generator.pulses: Hand-authored starts75/335/435, amplitudes57/72/-23, widths32/43/45; not fit to data
synthetic_generator.intervals: Unavailable; no independent synthetic interval calibration

scenarios.boundaries: half-open; inputs removed before features, evaluator retains original targets

restart: Sessions expire with HTTP410, events retained in ignored SQLite; no automatic recovery
scientific_boundary: Exploratory processed-data replay; upstream interpolation unresolved; no clinical/live validation or guaranteed coverage
